page_title: REI 1-2 MNT | Reims v Montpellier 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Pierre Gaillouste has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Adama Bojang (Reims) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Silvan Hefti and he is replaced by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier).

86' 1 - 2 Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Yehvann Diouf is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) for Akor Adams.
83' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
82' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) earns the yellow card.
82' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
82' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
80' Here comes a substitution. Sergio Akieme is given a rest as he is replaced by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
80' The game has come to an end for Oumar Diakite. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Adama Bojang (Reims).
78' 4:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
73' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
72' Teddy Teuma (Reims) prepares to take a corner kick.
72' Junya Ito (Reims) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Reims have a corner.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch for Arnaud Nordin.
72' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) replacing Tanguy Coulibaly.
70' Teddy Teuma (Reims) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
69' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) picked up a yellow card from referee.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Therence Koudou trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
66' 1 - 1 Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
66' Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
65' Teddy Teuma (Reims) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
61' Good clearance! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
59' Akor Adams (Montpellier) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
59' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
57' Will Still has decided to make a change. Teddy Teuma (Reims) replaces Amir Richardson.
57' Keito Nakamura goes off the pitch and Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) comes on.
56' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
54' Junya Ito (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' Keito Nakamura (Reims) takes the free kick from long distance. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
52' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Reda Khadra (Reims) serves up a nice cross, but Benjamin Lecomte punches the ball away.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marshall Munetsi (Reims) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
47' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Junya Ito (Reims), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
47' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) picks up a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Sergio Akieme (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
44' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) and Tanguy Coulibaly attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
42' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

40' What a save from Benjamin Lecomte! Marshall Munetsi (Reims) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
39' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul after Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) hacks down one of his opponents.
38' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
36' Keito Nakamura (Reims) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
35' Keito Nakamura (Reims) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Reda Khadra (Reims) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
30' Amir Richardson (Reims) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
28' Keito Nakamura (Reims) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
26' 0 - 1 It's in! Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the bottom left corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Joris Chotard. 0:1.
26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
23' The game is interrupted now, Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
20' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take a corner kick.
17' The ball is cleared after Oumar Diakite (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' The game is interrupted as Keito Nakamura (Reims) is flagged offside.
13' Amir Richardson (Reims) meets a cross inside the box, but Benjamin Lecomte wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
10' Reims quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
9' That's unlucky! Keito Nakamura (Reims) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
6' Junya Ito (Reims) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
5' Reims hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

2' Akor Adams (Montpellier) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
2' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste is the one to supervise the game today.
